$comment: Reference material parsed from Spencer's CABIIN 2.0 board game. Not game content and not imported at runtime. Board/team/zone/movement rules are intentionally not carried into Drink at Ron; see docs/CARD_VOICE_REFERENCE.md.

cards.title: Smooth Brain
cards.body: Tell a story about a time you were REAL dumb. Drink 2.

cards.title: FaceTime Trivia
cards.body: The group asks you a trivia question. If wrong, drink d6/3 and no one talks to you for one round.

cards.title: County Commissioner
cards.body: Give a speech on why you should be in charge. Drink for each team that wouldn't vote for you.

cards.title: Bitch Babe
cards.body: You must refer to everyone on your team as babe, and everyone else as bitch for 2 rounds. Give 2 drinks.

cards.title: Abra
cards.body: Teleport to Kadabra.

cards.title: Atlanta Airport
cards.body:
These planes are sus. Roll a die and drink that many. That is the maximum amount of spaces you can move each roll while in
this Zone.

cards.title: Freddie's Run
cards.body: You ran to the store. Skip your next turn. While you're up, get anyone anything they need.

cards.title: International Eric
cards.body: Take a shot of liquor cause you like it now. You have immunity to SS Allure. Else, you have to stop on SS Allure.

cards.title: Going the Distance
cards.body:
Give drinks equal to the total number of travel hours it took you to get to the cabin. Idle time
doesn't count.

cards.title: Drunken Clam
cards.body: How the fuck did this get here? Roll a die. If you roll a 1, drink 1. Else get blindside punched in the face and finish your drink.

cards.title: Mint Chev
cards.body: It comes with empty beer cans in the back. Crush a full beer and leave the smashed can on the table to roll again. Else drink d6/3.

cards.title: Bartender Greg
cards.body:
Hit on someone, share d6 free drinks with them. Try not to die on the free ride home and don't forget to send them a 4AM 
‘U up?" text.

cards.title: I Don't Know Shit About Fuck
cards.body: Tell the group something you embarrassingly don't know/understand. Everyone drinks 2.

cards.title: Do Not Cum
cards.body:
Roll a die:
1-6: Cum. Drink that many.

cards.title: Dafuq Did I Just Hear?
cards.body: You just admitted to loving Lance, drink until the group is happy.

cards.title: Drinks On Me, Bring Your Card
cards.body: Get someone a fresh drink, but have them pay you some amount of money. Both drink 1.

cards.title: I'm the Captain Now
cards.body: Get an extra roll and reverse turn direction.

cards.title: Ride the Bus
cards.body: You pick a suit but are totally wrong. Drink 4.

cards.title: Corporate Meeting
cards.body: This could have been an email. Drink for everyone who's landed here.

cards.title: Allegiant Airlines
cards.body: It's cheap AF until it's not. Give d6.

cards.title: Mosby
cards.body:
Pet the best dog in
the room.

cards.title: Spirit Airlines
cards.body:
1's are now 0's for everyone until you get to the next Landmark. Drink
3 now.

cards.title: Gengar
cards.body: Guess your roll to move any token to 1 adjacent Space (even through walls). They must play it. Drink X.

cards.title: Voltorb
cards.body:
Choose X amount of people to finish their drinks (people can't be
picked twice).

cards.title: Alakazam
cards.body: Basically Kadabra with another spoon. Pick someone to teleport to you. Spoon them and both drink X+2.

cards.title: Ursaring
cards.body:
Roll 1-3: Ursaring stays asleep. Give X and don't speak until your next turn.
Else, you woke his ass up. Drink a full beer +1
and apologize.

cards.title: Lance
cards.body:
The dragon champion. He's dragon his nuts across your face. Drink X+2.
If you landed on Dafuq Did I Just Hear? give
these instead.

cards.title: Stonks
cards.body: Smoke something if you want to (and are cool) then chill here. You are immune from drinks this round.

cards.title: Do Better
cards.body: Drink 1 more than the next player drinks on their turn.

cards.title: Café d'Époque
cards.body: Everyone here is a total skank. Now you are too. Drink for every team in this Zone and also hit on them.

cards.title: Neighbors
cards.body: Everyone not staying in your cabin must drink 1.

cards.title: Comradery
cards.body: Your team shouts your Official Team Cheer and drinks 2.

cards.title: Soooo It's Thursday
cards.body: Give X to someone to calm their nerves.

cards.title: Ow Scratchies
cards.body: Show and explain to the group a scar you have. Everyone drink 2 in pain.

cards.title: That's Two Beers
cards.body: Give out 24 drinks.

cards.title: Chaud
cards.body: Microwave your drink.

cards.title: Guess I'll Die
cards.body:
Roll 3 dice. If any of them are the same number, move to the player in
last place.

cards.title: I'm Gonna Cum
cards.body: If you landed on Do Not Cum give d6 drinks and everyone applauds you. Else, cum and drink d6.

cards.title: We're Not That Drunk
cards.body:
Ignore the next Space you land on.
Or pound a full drink and
roll again.

cards.title: SS Allure
cards.body: Roll two dice. First die, skip half that many turns. Second die, drink that many each turn.

cards.title: Asshole
cards.body: You have to do what everyone says while on this Space.

cards.title: Cave Herpes
cards.body: If you land on this Space you must roll a 4-5 to leave. Drink 2 every time you get stuck.

cards.title: Pokemon League
cards.body: You can only say your first name while in this Zone. X is equal to the amount of official badges you own.

cards.title: Children's Cabin
cards.body: Get absolutely STONED or drink 1 every time someone takes a turn until your next turn.

cards.title: CABIIN
cards.body:
Roll a die to join a team.
Teams use same color tokens.
1-2: Florida   3-4: Michigan   5-6: Wisconsin

Legend
Blue: Landmark. Stop here.
Grey: Zone. Special rules apply here and connected Landmarks.
All squares count as Spaces.

Always round up when applicable.

cards.title: Group Effort
cards.body: Teammates advance together if they're on the same Space in this Zone. Advance 1 space on success. Other teams drink 3 now.

cards.title: 4th Meal
cards.body: Fly to Ireland and get a tattoo right now. Otherwise drink d6/3.

cards.title: 85.21% Birthday
cards.body:
Surprise the shit out of someone by each drinking 85.21% of a drink of
your choosing.

cards.title: Too Soon O'Conner
cards.body: Hit the NOS and skip the next Landmark.

cards.title: Get Natured
cards.body: Drink 1 outside.

cards.title: Wisconsin
cards.body: The real mitten state. Drink 7 - d6 because you're better. If this is your team, give 7 - d6.

cards.title: Like I Said
cards.body: Mimic the person during their turn. Drink 2.

cards.title: Steve's Spyder Beanie
cards.body: It has protected his head for longer than he's been alive. Return all drinks given to you to the sender while here.

cards.title: Samesies
cards.body: Roll 2 die. If they match, give the total and advance. Else, drink half the total.

cards.title: Team Speech
cards.body:
Your team has to give a speech using one word per person at a time. Then, your team drinks 1 for
each teammate.

cards.title: Madi Booty
cards.body: Roll 3 dice and add the totals. Play a round of Madi Booty with that number.

cards.title: Deez Nuts
cards.body: You are now Deez. If you make someone fall for a deez nuts joke, they drink 3. Gottem.

cards.title: Ohio
cards.body: That sucks. This is your team now. Wear something stupid. Previous teammates drink 2 and you drink half their total.

cards.title: How Many Holes You Got?
cards.body: Give out 1 for every beer you've finished this game so far +1.

cards.title: Numbers
cards.body: Drink for every number that exists or until the group is happy.

cards.title: Someone Call 9-1
cards.body: Drink for every injury that happened this trip.

cards.title: Final Showdown
cards.body: Play Thunderstruck, but you can drink anytime. Anyone who lands here can join in progress. Everyone who finishes 2 beers before Thunderstruck ends while on this space are the current Cabin Daddies.

cards.title: King of the Hill
cards.body: Roll higher than all of your teammates in this Zone (or 6 if solo) to advance. Else, drink 2 for each teammate.

cards.title: That's My Boyd
cards.body: Guess your roll to get your boyd and advance. Else, that is not your boyd and drink 4.

cards.title: Miller Mike
cards.body: Your next full drink is chosen by the group.

cards.title: I Can't Believe You've Done This
cards.body: Pour someone's drink out. Their next roll is halved.

cards.title: Another One
cards.body: Drink the previous amount you owed and roll again.

cards.title: Silly Salmon
cards.body:
Flop on the floor and
drink 1.

cards.title: Florida
cards.body: Let everyone know how nice Florida is and drink d6/2 warm drinks. If this is your team, give d6/2 warm drinks instead.

cards.title: Pipe Bomb
cards.body: Guess 1-6, if you roll your guess you blow up and do a pipe bomb.

cards.title: No Take Just Throw
cards.body: Throw d6 drinks someones way and make them wiggle butt in honor of Coffee.

cards.title: Almost Lost My Cool There
cards.body:
If someone got angry this game, tell them to calm down (which helps), and give them 3 drinks.
Else, rage and drink 3.

cards.title: Crypto
cards.body: Move forward or backwards (coin flip) d6 spaces and drink that many.

cards.title: Medium Rare Chicken
cards.body:
Drink 2 for every player that threw up during
this trip.

cards.title: Mustard Tiger
cards.body: Drink as much as the person who drank the most this game, or move to the Space in last place.

cards.title: Hot Dog Water
cards.body: You insult Mike Davis and everyone hates you. Go back 10 spaces and never apologize to anyone.

cards.title: Ski Team
cards.body:
If you're a skier, skiers
drink 2.
If you're a snowboarder, snowboarders drink 2.
Else, drink 4 and grow up.

cards.title: What An Idiot
cards.body:
Make someone finish
their drink.

cards.title: I'm Sorry Baby
cards.body:
Roll a die:
1: You're a nobody drink 4.
2-4: You receive a "Smoochie-Smoochie" drink 2.
5-6: The night closes in. Give 3 drinks.

cards.title: Deans
cards.body:
Pooh-Bear 3 drinks
like Spencer
Pooh-Bear's Deans.

cards.title: You Son of a Bitch I'm In
cards.body: 1 person can offer you a drink type and quantity. Both people drink it.

cards.title: Seems Like a Real Piece of Shit
cards.body: You are now the beer wench for 3 turns.

cards.title: Part of the Ship, Part of the Crew
cards.body: Pick up to 3 people to be part of your crew. You all drink every time the crew drinks until your next turn.

cards.title: For Safety
cards.body: Your next drink is a water or hydrating drink.

cards.title: Yoink!
cards.body:
Move someone back
d6 spaces.

cards.title: Get Good
cards.body: Roll a die. Move to the person in the rank equal to your roll (Roll 1, move to 1st, etc).

cards.title: What Is? Give
cards.body: Have someone get you the same type of drink that they are drinking. Both drink d6-3.

cards.title: Mike Bet
cards.body: Guess what time it will be when the first person lands on Miller Mike. Closest guess avoids 6 drinks. If no one lands on it, everyone takes a shot (unless you guessed no-show).

cards.title: Michigan
cards.body: Drink 3 from an ice cold drink and explain how its not even cold. If this is your team, give 3 cold drinks instead.

cards.title: Dream Team
cards.body: You may split drinks with teammates that are located in this Zone.

cards.title: President
cards.body: Give orders to anyone while on this Space.

cards.title: 3rd World Christmas
cards.body: While on this Space, you can give anyone a gift and they must use/wear it for the remainder of the game.

cards.title: Fuck You In Particular
cards.body: Roll a die, subtract that number from 10 and drink that number.

cards.title: Kadabra
cards.body: Abra's dumbass brother. Trade Spaces with someone if you landed here. Abra-ing like a slut doesn't count.

cards.title: God's Chosen
cards.body: If you've had COVID, drink 3. Else, give 3.

cards.title: Thanos Snap
cards.body:
Pick half the people in the game to miss their next turn. Everyone else
drinks 2.

cards.title: It's Gotta Go
cards.body: Finish your drink.
